description: Token-kind classification for the claude.ai/design adherence check. The DS check flags every CSS custom property the compiled _ds_bundle.css emits but can't classify. Most of those are Tailwind/runtime internals (--tw-*, transition/animation plumbing) that are NOT theme tokens — they're injected by Tailwind at build time and are absent from app/globals.css, so they cannot be annotated at source. This map (consumed by the /design-sync pipeline) classifies them as 'other' so the check stays clean. Rule of thumb: every --tw-*, plus --ease-*, --animate-*, --default-transition-* => 'other'. Do NOT rename these — Tailwind utilities depend on the names; only classify them.
